bis_cpi.label: Consumer prices
bis_cpi.plain: BIS national consumer-price inflation, annual percentage change. National CPI definitions; monthly observations.

bis_euro_policy_rate.label: ECB policy rate
bis_euro_policy_rate.plain: BIS policy-rate series for the euro area, end of month. Shared monetary policy; see BIS instrument definitions.

bis_policy_rate.label: Policy rate
bis_policy_rate.plain: BIS central-bank policy rate, end of month. Instrument definitions vary by monetary authority.

ecb_mortgage_rate.label: ECB mortgage rate (Spain)
ecb_mortgage_rate.plain: The interest rate banks are charging on new mortgages to households, sourced from the ECB's Monetary Interest Rates dataset.

electricity_demand.label: Electricity load · daily
electricity_demand.plain: National electricity consumption in MWh, including data centres. Unadjusted for weather, electrification, efficiency and sector composition.

electricity_large_users.label: Large-user power demand
electricity_large_users.plain: Publisher-corrected electricity index for mainland Spanish businesses with contracted power above 450 kW. 2021=100.

geopolitical_risk.label: Geopolitical news exposure
geopolitical_risk.plain: Country-specific geopolitical risk: share of newspaper articles mentioning geopolitical risk and the country or major cities. US newspaper perspective. Caldara and Iacoviello.

hiring_new.label: New job postings
hiring_new.plain: Seasonally adjusted new job postings, seven-day average. February 2020=100.

hiring_total.label: Hiring intentions
hiring_total.plain: Seasonally adjusted total job postings, seven-day average. February 2020=100.

macro_employment.label: Employment
macro_employment.plain: Persons employed, domestic concept; quarter-on-quarter change, seasonally and calendar adjusted.

macro_gdp.label: Real GDP
macro_gdp.plain: Quarter-on-quarter real GDP growth; seasonally and calendar adjusted.

macro_house_prices.label: House prices
macro_house_prices.plain: Annual change in transacted prices of new and existing dwellings; unadjusted.

macro_industry.label: Industrial production
macro_industry.plain: Production excluding construction; seasonally and calendar adjusted, 2021=100.

macro_inflation.label: Consumer prices
macro_inflation.plain: All-items HICP, annual rate of change; ECOICOP 2.

macro_retail.label: Retail sales
macro_retail.plain: Retail trade volume, excluding motor vehicles; seasonally and calendar adjusted, 2021=100.

macro_sentiment.label: Economic sentiment
macro_sentiment.plain: DG ECFIN survey composite; long-run average=100. Expectations, not realised output.

macro_unemployment.label: Unemployment
macro_unemployment.plain: Share of the labour force unemployed; seasonally adjusted.

oecd_cli.label: Composite leading indicator
oecd_cli.plain: OECD amplitude-adjusted composite leading indicator. Long-run trend=100; harmonised methodology. Tracks cyclical turning points relative to trend.

power_carbon_intensity.label: Power carbon intensity
power_carbon_intensity.plain: Emissions per unit of electricity generated. A lens on industrial carbon exposure and changes in the generation mix.

power_demand.label: Electricity load · monthly
power_demand.plain: Aggregate electricity consumption, including data centres. Weather, electrification, efficiency and sector composition are not controlled. Energy demand exposure.

power_fossil_share.label: Fossil power exposure
power_fossil_share.plain: Share of electricity generated from fossil fuels. Exposure to fuel costs and energy transitions; not a direct measure of GDP.

power_price.label: Wholesale power price
power_price.plain: Monthly day-ahead electricity price in euros per MWh, where reported by Ember. Not an end-user tariff.

shipping_calls.label: Port traffic
shipping_calls.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated port traffic at covered ports. Sum of five vessel categories in IMF PortWatch. Includes transshipment; not official customs trade. Not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_container_exports.label: Container exports
shipping_container_exports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated container-vessel exports at covered ports, in tonnes. Includes transshipment. Cargo classified by vessel type; not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_container_imports.label: Container imports
shipping_container_imports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated container-vessel imports at covered ports, in tonnes. Includes transshipment. Cargo classified by vessel type; not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_exports.label: Seaborne exports
shipping_exports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated seaborne exports at covered ports. Sum of five vessel categories in IMF PortWatch. Includes transshipment; not official customs trade. Not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_imports.label: Seaborne imports
shipping_imports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated seaborne imports at covered ports. Sum of five vessel categories in IMF PortWatch. Includes transshipment; not official customs trade. Not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_tanker_exports.label: Tanker exports
shipping_tanker_exports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated tanker-vessel exports at covered ports, in tonnes. Includes transshipment. Cargo classified by vessel type; not seasonally adjusted.

shipping_tanker_imports.label: Tanker imports
shipping_tanker_imports.plain: Monthly AIS-estimated tanker-vessel imports at covered ports, in tonnes. Includes transshipment. Cargo classified by vessel type; not seasonally adjusted.

wb_gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth · annual
wb_gdp_growth.plain: Annual real GDP growth from World Bank WDI; historical benchmark, not a current-quarter estimate.

wb_gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person · PPP
wb_gdp_per_capita.plain: Constant 2021 international dollars per person, adjusted for purchasing power.

wb_inflation.label: Consumer inflation · annual
wb_inflation.plain: Annual consumer-price inflation from World Bank WDI. Different definition and frequency from monthly Eurostat HICP.

wb_population.label: Population
wb_population.plain: Total population; annual World Bank estimate.

wb_trade.label: Trade openness
wb_trade.plain: Exports plus imports of goods and services as a share of GDP; annual.

wb_unemployment.label: Unemployment · annual
wb_unemployment.plain: Annual ILO-modelled unemployment rate. Annual context, not a monthly labour-market reading.

ecb.license: ECB copyright, data available under CC BY 4.0

ember.notes: National monthly electricity demand, fossil generation share, carbon intensity and available day-ahead prices. Source lags vary by country. Demand is not weather-adjusted; energy mix is exposure, not a growth forecast.

eurostat_macro.notes: GDP, jobs, prices, industry, retail, sentiment and housing for six European countries. Quarterly series use their own freshness limits in the country dashboard.

gpr.attribution: Source: Dario Caldara and Matteo Iacoviello, Geopolitical Risk Index

indeed_daily.license: CC BY 4.0 (Hiring Lab repository); verify redistribution before commercial delivery
indeed_daily.notes: Daily seasonally adjusted total and new job posting indices. 1 February 2020=100; publisher uses a seven-day moving average. Platform coverage is not the whole labour market.

portwatch.license: IMF terms of use; confirm applicable commercial redistribution rights
portwatch.attribution: Sources: UN Global Platform; IMF PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org). Country aggregates calculated by CitySignal.
portwatch.notes: Monthly AIS-estimated physical imports, exports and port calls. Covered ports only; includes transshipment. Not customs trade, dollar values, seasonally adjusted data or a GDP forecast.

ree.license: Red Eléctrica legal notice; commercial redistribution requires review
ree.notes: National daily electricity demand (MWh) and mainland corrected large-user electricity index (>450 kW). Electricity is a proxy, affected by weather, efficiency and sector mix.

worldbank.license: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank open data terms)
worldbank.attribution: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators
worldbank.notes: Annual GDP growth, consumer inflation, modelled unemployment, population, PPP-adjusted real GDP per person and trade openness for 28 major markets. Historical benchmarks, excluded from the activity reading.

availability_policy: Use fetched_at as the first capture date for each revision, not as a historical publication timestamp. Missing published_at means unknown. Backfilled observations were not available to this system before their capture date. Daily capture dates do not support intraday replay.

derived_metrics.hiring_flow_gap: 28-day new-posting growth minus total-posting growth (pp). Inputs: hiring_new, hiring_total.
derived_metrics.trade_flow_gap: Export tonnage y/y growth minus import tonnage y/y growth (pp), matching months. Inputs: shipping_exports, shipping_imports. These computed spreads are available in the dashboard; CSV files preserve their raw inputs.

commercial_status: Source-specific attribution and redistribution terms are recorded in the source registry.
